column3: SH-01 Agree the frontend framework and set up the repository
column4:
Agree one frontend framework with the team, create the shared Git repository and set a folder structure where each person works in their own feature folder.

h3. User stories
* CORE-003: As an administrator, I want to follow a consistent interface across features and webpages, so that the application feels like one coherent product.

None.

h3. Data in and out
None.

* Repository created; Farhan and Midhir have write access

_Plan ticket SH-01 · Week 1_

column3: SH-02 Build shared design tokens and base components
column4:
Turn the agreed Coastal Trust palette and type into shared tokens and base components that every screen uses. Shawn supplied the direction; Midhir coordinates how it is applied.

h3. User stories
* CORE-002: As a user, I want to use the application with a keyboard and on mobile, so that I can complete the main journey accessibly.
* CORE-003: As an administrator, I want to follow a consistent interface across features and webpages, so that the application feels like one coherent product.

h3. What to build
* Tokens: colours (Deep Ocean #12324A, Ocean Teal #0B7A6E, Seafoam #5CC4A6 and tint #DDF3EC, Coastal Mist #F4F8F7, Shoreline #D3E3DE, Tide Grey #4E6677, plus match / caution / stop status colours), type scale, spacing scale, 6px radius
* Fonts: Familjen Grotesk (headings, menu), Atkinson Hyperlegible (body), IBM Plex Mono (IDs and water readings)
* Button: primary, secondary, quiet, danger, small, large, disabled
* Form controls: text input, number input, select, textarea, checkbox, choice card (radio styled as a card), field label, hint and error message
* Status chip: one component that takes any listing, request, guidance or compatibility status value and picks the colour
* Panel, notice (info, success, warning, error) and page header
* Specimen plate: coloured panel with scientific name and a fish or leaf line icon, coloured by habitat group
* Component examples page so others can copy usage

h3. States to handle
* Hover
* Keyboard focus (visible ring)
* Disabled
* Error

h3. Data in and out
Status values from SH-03 contracts.

h3. Depends on
Needs SH-01. Unblocks every screen.

h3. Where to look in the prototype
Prototype → footer → Design system page (colours, type, buttons, chips, fields, range bar, tracker, card). Every screen in the prototype uses these.
Prototype: https://aquabridge-zeta.vercel.app/prototype/

h3. Acceptance criteria
* Token values match the prototype’s design system page
* All listed components exist and are used from one shared folder
* Status chip renders every value in the contracts with a text label, not colour alone
* Every interactive component shows a visible focus ring
* Text contrast meets WCAG AA on the Coastal Mist and white backgrounds

_Plan ticket SH-02 · Week 1_

column3: SH-03 Define shared mock data contracts, IDs and fixtures
column4:
Agree the shapes and IDs that cross feature boundaries so everyone builds against the same sample data. Each person writes the fixtures for their own entities.

h3. User stories
* CORE-001: As a user, I want to access the data and actions that belong to me, so that all data and information is protected.

h3. What to build
* Contracts file with types or JSDoc for Species, IntakeOutcome, Listing, HabitatProfile, HabitatSummary, CompatibilityResult, AdoptionRequest, User
* ID prefixes: SP- species, IC- intake, L- listing, H- habitat, R- request, U- user
* Status enums: listing draft / active / reserved / rehomed / withdrawn; request pending / accepted / declined / withdrawn / completed; compatibility potential_match / needs_information / blocked; guidance eligible / needs_review / restricted
* Fixtures: 10 species (incl. 2 restricted and ‘not sure’), 6+ listings across all statuses, 5 users, 3 habitats, requests in every status
* A reset function that restores fixtures for demos

h3. States to handle
None.

h3. Data in and out
Owns the shared contracts file. Farhan owns species and intake fixtures, Midhir owns habitat fixtures, Shawn owns listing and request fixtures.

h3. Depends on
Needs SH-01. Unblocks F-05, F-06, S-02, S-08, M-01, M-03.

Prototype → Screen map → ‘Shared contract values’ section lists every status and ID prefix.
Prototype: https://aquabridge-zeta.vercel.app/prototype/

* Every module imports fixtures from src/shared/mocks
* No screen hard-codes its own copy of another person’s data
* Reset restores the original fixtures

column3: SH-05 Login and sign-up screens with mock authentication and return-to-action
column4:
Mock signed-in and signed-out states, the login and sign-up screens, and route guards. The university-provided component replaces the form later, so keep it behind one small auth module.

h3. User stories
* REG-001: As a user, I want to create an account, so that I can save my listings, habitat information and requests.
* REG-002: As a user, I want to sign in to my account, so that I can access my saved information.
* REG-003: As a user, I want to log out of my account, so that someone else cannot use my session when I leave.
* REG-004: As an owner, I want to see clear login and registration errors, so that I can correct my details and continue.
* REG-005: As an owner, I want to reach the right account pages after signing in, so that I can manage my listings, habitat profile and requests.
* CORE-001: As a user, I want to access the data and actions that belong to me, so that all data and information is protected.

h3. What to build
* Log in and Sign up tabs on one page: name (sign-up only), email, password, submit
* ‘You’ll go back to: …’ notice when the user arrived from a guarded action
* Auth module: currentUser, signIn, signOut, requireAuth(route) used by every guarded route
* Pending-action store: remembers route and item ID (e.g. listing L-1044) in session storage, never in the URL
* Sign out from the account menu

h3. States to handle
* Empty fields error
* Invalid email format error
* Arrived from guarded action
* Arrived directly
* Already signed in

h3. Data in and out
Provides currentUser (U-01 in mocks) to every module.

h3. Depends on
Needs SH-02, SH-04.

h3. Where to look in the prototype
Prototype → Log in page; Demo Flow 1 step 8 and Flow 2 step 3 show the return notice.
Prototype: https://aquabridge-zeta.vercel.app/prototype/

h3. Acceptance criteria
* Guarded routes (editor, My Listings, Incoming requests, My Habitat, compatibility, request, My Requests) send signed-out users to login
* After login the user lands on the page and item they were heading to
* Questionnaire answers survive login and never appear in the URL
* Empty or badly formatted email shows an error next to the field and focus moves there
* Sign out hides account pages and returns to the homepage

column3: F-04 Guidance outcomes: eligible, needs review and restricted
column4:
Explained example outcomes with alternative next steps, clearly marked as illustrative, not legal or veterinary advice.

h3. User stories
* GUID-004: As an owner, I want to receive explained rehoming or advice pathways, so that I know the responsible action to consider.
* GUID-005: As an owner, I want to be warned when identification or transfer rules are uncertain, so that I do not accidentally publish an inappropriate listing.
* GUID-006: As an owner, I want to see other guidance when rehoming is not possible or urgent, so that I have a useful next step even without an online match.
* SPEC-003: As a user, I want to see when species advice is incomplete or unverified, so that I can recognise missing or unverified information before making a decision.

h3. What to build
* Example rule function: restricted species → restricted; unidentified or unwell → needs_review; otherwise eligible
* Outcome card with coloured edge, status chip, headline, one-line summary and ‘Why you’re seeing this’ reasons from the answers
* Next steps list: eligible → ‘Also worth doing’; needs review → identify, wait for treatment, keep it where it is; restricted → keep caring, never release, contact a rescue or local authority
* Urgent (within a week) adds a short-term suggestion
* Buttons: Create my listing (eligible only), Change my answers, Start again
* ‘Illustrative only’ notice

h3. States to handle
* Eligible
* Needs review (unidentified)
* Needs review (unwell)
* Restricted
* Urgent variant

h3. Data in and out
Produces IntakeOutcome { intakeId, outcome, reasons[] }.

h3. Depends on
Needs F-03, F-05.

h3. Acceptance criteria
* All three outcomes reachable with sample answers
* Only eligible shows Create my listing
* Reasons reflect the actual answers
* Every outcome says it is illustrative
